modules.title: Changelog format
modules.prompt: Which changelog template should this project use?

variants.label: Default (sectioned tables, badge tags)
variants.description: Per-version files with top-level sections (Security, Performance, API, ...) and inline tag badges.

variants.label: Minimal (plain markdown, drop empty sections)
variants.description: Plain markdown only — headings and bullets, no tables or badges. Sections with zero entries are omitted.

modules.title: Version control conventions
modules.prompt: Which version-control template should this project use?

variants.label: Default
variants.description: Default conventions for commit messages, branches, and release flow.
